SELECT
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SL.SaleInvCode))),
	invcode = SL.saleinvcode,    
	Type     = 'S', 
	date       = SL.date,    
	custrefno = SL.custrefno,
	remarks = SL.remarks,
	saletype = (Select name from saletype where saletypecode = SL.saletypecode ),
	doctype 	= Case SL.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	/*invtotal = dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(SL.saleinvcode),*/
	invtotal = SL.invtotal,
	AliasName=AC.aliasname,
	CustomerName=AC.name,
	Address1 = C.Address1,
	Address2 = C.Address2,
	custcp2=C.cp2,
	City = C.City,
	Areaname=(select name from area where area.areacode=C.Areacode),
	accountfor=SL.accountfor,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=SL.doctcode),
	impactinventory=SL.impactinventory
FROM DBO.SaleLedger SL, DBO.Accounts AC, DBO.Users U, Customer C
WHERE 
	( SL.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)  And
	(SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) ) and 
	( SL.custcode = AC.acccode ) and  
	( AC.AccCode = C.CustCode ) AND
	( SL.salesmancode = U.usercode )
UNION ALL
SELECT
	documentcode = 'SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SL.SRInvCode))),
	invcode = SL.SRInvcode,    
	Type     = 'R',
	date       = SL.date,    
	custrefno = SL.custrefno,
	remarks = SL.remarks,
	saletype = NULL,
	doctype 	= Case SL.srcatcode When 8 Then 'Cash' When 6 Then 'Cash' Else 'Credit' End, 
	invtotal = -1 * dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(SL.srinvcode),
	AliasName=AC.aliasname,
	CustomerName=AC.name,
	Address1 = C.Address1,
	Address2 = C.Address2,
	custcp2=C.cp2,
	City = C.City,
	Areaname=(select name from area where area.areacode=C.Areacode),
	accountfor=SL.accountfor,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=SL.doctcode),
	impactinventory='Y'
	
FROM DBO.SRLedger SL, DBO.Accounts AC, DBO.Users U, Customer C
WHERE 
	( SL.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)  And
	(SL.srcatcode IN (:aa_saletype) ) and
	( SL.custcode = AC.acccode ) and  
	( AC.AccCode = C.CustCode ) AND
	( SL.salesmancode = U.usercode )
